bio.description: Sushi Akira is an intimate 12-seat omakase restaurant located on the Upper East Side, offering a unique dining experience that combines Michelin-level precision, artistry, and exceptional service. The restaurant aims to make high-quality omakase accessible to a wider audience, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere for sushi enthusiasts and newcomers alike.
bio.culinary_style: Sushi Akira specializes in omakase, featuring expertly crafted nigiri and seasonal small plates. The culinary focus is on traditional Japanese techniques, with an emphasis on fresh, high-quality ingredients and meticulous presentation.
bio.history: Chef-Owner Nikki honed her craft at renowned sushi establishments in New York City, including Masa and Sushi Nakazawa. Her culinary journey began in Tokyo, where she worked as a dishwasher in a Michelin-starred restaurant, igniting her passion for gastronomy. Despite the challenges of being a female sushi chef, Nikki has built a reputation for her exceptional skills and dedication to her guests.

bio.description: Nestled in the historic Doyers Street of Manhattan's Chinatown, Lei is an intimate 28-seat wine bar that offers a unique blend of classic and emerging wines. The ambiance is warm and inviting, making it an ideal spot for both casual diners and wine enthusiasts looking to explore a thoughtfully curated selection of wines paired with dishes inspired by regional Chinese home cooking.
bio.culinary_style: Lei focuses on regional Chinese home cooking, offering a menu designed to complement its diverse wine selection. The dishes are crafted to enhance the wine experience, with a constantly changing menu that reflects seasonal ingredients.

bio.description: Comal is a vibrant restaurant located in the Lower East Side of Manhattan, New York, that celebrates the rich culinary traditions of Mexico City. The restaurant embodies warmth and simplicity, creating a welcoming atmosphere that reflects the essence of Mexican hospitality. With a focus on peak-season produce from the Northeast US, sustainably caught seafood, and heritage meats, Comal offers a dining experience that is both flavorful and thoughtfully curated.
bio.culinary_style: Comal specializes in Mexican cuisine, emphasizing fresh and sustainable ingredients sourced from local farms. The menu features a variety of dishes that highlight the use of chiles, spices, and other traditional ingredients from Mexico, aiming to create deep and complex flavors.
bio.history: Founded by Gaz Herbert, who hails from Cuernavaca, Mexico, Comal is influenced by his experiences in both Mexico City and London's diverse dining scene.

bio.description: Smithereens is a seafood restaurant located in the East Village, offering a unique dining experience that celebrates the flavors and culinary traditions of New England. With a commitment to sourcing the finest ingredients from the Northeast and beyond, the restaurant provides a cozy yet sophisticated atmosphere for guests to enjoy a thoughtfully curated menu and an ever-evolving wine selection.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus at Smithereens is on seafood, with a menu that highlights the best seasonal offerings. The wine list is carefully curated and changes daily, emphasizing varietals such as riesling.

bio.description: La Dong offers a unique dining experience that combines modern Vietnamese cuisine with the charm of an Asian Colonial house setting in the heart of New York City. Guests are invited to explore a culinary journey that spans the diverse flavors from North to South Vietnam, all while enjoying a warm and welcoming atmosphere where hospitality is paramount.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant specializes in Modern Vietnamese food, showcasing a menu that reflects the rich culinary heritage along the Mekong River. La Dong emphasizes fresh ingredients and traditional recipes, providing a contemporary twist on classic dishes.
bio.history: Ms. Đồng welcomes you to her house in the middle of New York City.

bio.description: Sushi Sho is an intimate Omakase restaurant that has been serving exquisite sushi since 1983. With a seating capacity of just six at the sushi bar, the dining experience is highly personalized, allowing guests to savor a carefully curated selection of dishes crafted by master chef Aki Kawata. The ambiance reflects a commitment to traditional Japanese culinary artistry, where each meal is a celebration of simplicity and the unique flavors of the finest ingredients.
bio.culinary_style: Sushi Sho specializes in Edo-mae and Kansai style sushi, offering a chef's choice Omakase menu that features a 16-item course of assorted nigiri-based sushi. The restaurant emphasizes purity and balance in its dishes, showcasing the natural flavors of each ingredient.
bio.history: Sushi Sho was established in 1983 by master chef Aki Kawata, who has dedicated over 30 years to preserving the traditions of Japanese sushi. His early training took place at his family restaurant in Wakayama, Japan.

bio.description: Four Twenty Five, a distinguished restaurant by renowned Chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten, is located at 425 Park Avenue in New York City. This establishment seamlessly combines culinary excellence with architectural beauty, featuring a design by the acclaimed Lord Norman Foster. Guests can enjoy extraordinary dining experiences across its Mezzanine and Street levels, highlighted by a captivating cocktail lounge and an intimate dining room that overlooks Park Avenue.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant focuses on innovative cuisine that emphasizes sustainability and local sourcing. Signature techniques include the use of vegetable juices, fruit essences, and herbal vinaigrettes, moving away from traditional meat stocks and creams. The menu reflects a commitment to working with local farmers and sustainable seafood suppliers.
bio.history: In 2023, Jean-Georges opened Four Twenty Five, marking the 62nd restaurant in his global repertoire. His culinary journey began in 1986 at Lafayette, just steps away from the current location.

bio.description: One White Street is a welcoming neighborhood restaurant located in a historic Tribeca townhouse in downtown New York City. The restaurant embodies a spirit of hospitality and inclusivity, inspired by a legendary love story from the 1970s. With a relaxed atmosphere, it invites guests to enjoy a re-imagined dining experience that celebrates global ideas and local ingredients.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus at One White Street is on ingredient-driven, globally inspired cuisine. The menu features an a la carte selection as well as a five-course chef’s tasting menu, highlighting seasonal offerings. Signature techniques include sourcing exceptional ingredients from Rigor Hill Farm in Columbia County, New York.

bio.description: Le Pavillon, located in the iconic One Vanderbilt skyscraper, offers a refined yet inviting dining experience that celebrates seasonal French cuisine. With a design that incorporates lush gardens and olive trees, the restaurant evokes a sense of natural splendor, making it a unique setting for both intimate gatherings and larger celebrations. The atmosphere is relaxed yet elegant, reflecting Chef Daniel Boulud's culinary roots and his commitment to fine dining in New York City.
bio.culinary_style: Le Pavillon focuses on seafood and vegetable-forward cuisine, rooted in French tradition while embracing contemporary techniques. The menu is innovative and seasonal, highlighting the richness of Northeast fishermen and farmers. Signature techniques include a close attention to seasonality and a celebration of local ingredients.
bio.history: Chef Daniel Boulud, a native of Lyon, France, has been a leading culinary authority in New York since 1982. His culinary journey has led to numerous accolades and the evolution of his cuisine across various locations, while remaining grounded in the rhythm of the seasons.

bio.description: Hyun is a stylish and minimalist Korean barbecue restaurant located in New York City, dedicated to providing an authentic experience of Korean food and culture. The restaurant emphasizes harmony between food, atmosphere, and space, ensuring a pleasurable dining experience that reflects the rich traditions of Korean cuisine.
bio.culinary_style: Hyun specializes in Korean barbecue, focusing on the meticulous selection and preparation of high-quality meats, particularly top-grade Japanese wagyu beef. The menu features dishes prepared on the same day, showcasing expert techniques that highlight the natural flavors of fresh ingredients.

bio.description: Soothr LIC, located in Long Island City, NY, offers a vibrant and immersive dining experience inspired by the bustling heart of Bangkok's Yaowarat Chinatown. The restaurant combines fresh ingredients and authentic flavors with a lively atmosphere, where guests can enjoy a unique blend of culinary delights and enchanting performances. With a focus on creating memorable moments, Soothr transforms every meal into a celebration of food, fun, and fantasy.
bio.culinary_style: Soothr specializes in Thai cuisine, featuring a menu that highlights traditional recipes with a playful twist. The dining format encourages exploration of various dishes, allowing guests to experience a range of flavors and textures. Signature techniques include the use of fresh, locally sourced ingredients and innovative presentations that reflect the vibrant culture of Chinatown.
bio.history: A-Mei, the restaurant's spirited host, brings recipes passed down from her sister, J'Hong, infusing them with her own creative flair. Soothr LIC aims to create an immersive journey through Chinatown life, evolving from a comforting tea house by day to a nostalgic jazz club by night.

bio.description: Ruffian is a pioneering wine bar and chef's table that specializes in Eastern European natural wines and seasonal dishes, creating a vibrant and immersive dining experience. Established in 2016, it has become a beloved neighborhood fixture, recognized as a NY Times Critic's Pick and awarded a Michelin Bib Gourmand each year since 2020. The restaurant offers a dynamic atmosphere where guests can enjoy a variety of tasting and à la carte menus, curated wine flights, and engaging wine classes.
bio.culinary_style: Ruffian focuses on Eastern European cuisine, featuring seasonal dishes that complement its extensive natural wine selection. The menu includes both tasting and à la carte options, emphasizing creative small plates and dynamic pairings.
bio.history: Ruffian has been a neighborhood fixture since 2016 and has received a Michelin Bib Gourmand each year since 2020.

bio.description: Bohemian Spirit Restaurant offers an authentic Czech dining experience in a warm and inviting atmosphere. With a focus on traditional Czech cuisine, the restaurant provides a unique culinary journey that reflects the rich cultural heritage of the Czech Republic.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant specializes in authentic Czech food and drinks, featuring a menu that highlights traditional dishes. Guests can enjoy a brunch menu on weekends and a dinner service that showcases the depth of Czech culinary techniques.

bio.description: Huso, located in Tribeca, offers a refined fine-dining experience under the guidance of Executive Chef Buddha Lo. With a focus on warm hospitality and thoughtful service, the restaurant presents an evolving tasting menu that highlights the best seasonal ingredients. The ambiance reflects a commitment to precision and creativity, making it a standout destination for discerning diners.
bio.culinary_style: Huso specializes in contemporary tasting menus that emphasize seasonality and technique. The culinary approach is ingredient-driven, showcasing a range of caviar and other seasonal delicacies. The menu is designed to balance creativity with restraint, ensuring a memorable dining experience.
bio.history: Huso originally began in 2019 inside Marky’s Caviar on Madison Avenue as an intimate 12-seat tasting counter. It has since moved to a larger location in Tribeca, where it has earned a One MICHELIN Star in 2025 and recognition as one of Robb Report’s 10 Best New Restaurants in America.

bio.description: Muku is a Japanese restaurant in New York City that embodies the philosophy of purity and intention in its culinary offerings. With a focus on seasonality and simplicity, Muku creates a dining experience that is both expressive and respectful of traditional Japanese cuisine. The restaurant's atmosphere is designed to reflect harmony, allowing guests to appreciate the true character of each dish without unnecessary embellishments.
bio.culinary_style: Muku specializes in nihonryori, or Japanese cuisine, with a menu that celebrates the five classical techniques of Japanese cooking: raw, grilled, simmered, steamed, and fried. The dishes are crafted with a focus on seasonal ingredients, ensuring that flavors are clear and direct, while also allowing for a quietly inventive approach to traditional recipes.
bio.history: Led by award-winning Chef Manabu Asanuma, who has trained under esteemed masters in Japan and has worked in acclaimed kitchens in New York, Muku represents a culmination of his diverse culinary experiences. Chef Asanuma's journey includes recognition in Japan's RED U-35 competition and a commitment to expressing his philosophy of seasonality and purity in every dish.

bio.description: Yamada is a refined dining establishment located in New York City, offering an intimate and immersive experience centered around a meticulously crafted 10-course kaiseki tasting menu. Guided by the principles of seasonality, harmony, and mindfulness, the restaurant blends traditional Japanese culinary techniques with innovative presentations, creating a multi-sensory journey that respects the heritage of kaiseki while showcasing Chef Isao Yamada's distinctive style. The ambiance is sophisticated yet welcoming, with a smart casual dress code that enhances the overall dining experience.
bio.culinary_style: Yamada specializes in kaiseki cuisine, featuring a seasonal tasting menu that emphasizes the artful progression of flavor, texture, and technique. The menu is available from Tuesday to Saturday and is designed to be savored over approximately two hours. Signature techniques include a customary tea ceremony that concludes the dining experience, reflecting the origins of kaiseki in 16th century Japan.
bio.history: Chef Isao Yamada is a master of kaiseki cuisine, having honed his craft at prestigious establishments in Japan before opening Kaiseki Hanaei in Fukuoka in 2000. He later moved to New York City to help open Brushstroke, where he earned a Michelin star. Yamada's return to New York with his eponymous restaurant marks a deeply personal expression of kaiseki.

bio.description: Crane Club is a sophisticated dining destination in New York, offering a vibrant atmosphere that combines elegance with a lively social scene. The restaurant features a stunning raw bar and a diverse menu that showcases a blend of seafood and contemporary American cuisine, making it an ideal spot for both casual gatherings and special occasions.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus at Crane Club centers around fresh seafood and high-quality meats, with a menu that includes a variety of raw bar selections, pasta dishes, and grilled specialties. Signature techniques include the use of premium ingredients and innovative flavor combinations, presented in a refined manner.

bio.description: Ishq is a vibrant dining destination in the heart of New York City, where the essence of Indian culinary heritage is celebrated through innovative and artistic presentations. The restaurant embodies the spirit of 'Ishq', meaning love or passion, and offers an unforgettable experience for both private celebrations and corporate functions. With a focus on storytelling through food, each dish is a tribute to age-old recipes, meticulously crafted to evoke the warmth of home-cooked Indian meals while appealing to modern palates.
bio.culinary_style: Ishq specializes in Indian cuisine, featuring a menu that includes aromatic curries and flavorful tandoori dishes. The culinary approach combines traditional recipes with contemporary plating techniques, creating a unique dining experience that highlights the richness of India's diverse culinary regions.
bio.history: About Chef Vamshi adi

bio.description: Yellow Rose is a vibrant dining destination in New York City that celebrates the rich culinary heritage of South Texas. Founded by Dave and Krystiana Rizo in November 2020, the restaurant offers a warm and inviting atmosphere where guests can enjoy authentic Texas cuisine infused with local New York ingredients. The menu features a variety of dishes made from scratch, reflecting the couple's deep-rooted connections to their hometown of San Antonio.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus at Yellow Rose is on genuine Texas cooking, with a menu that includes Texas classics like fresh flour tortillas filled with stewed beef in chili gravy. The restaurant also offers daily specials that highlight seasonal produce from New York State, all prepared with a Texas twist.
bio.history: Yellow Rose is the brainchild of Dave and Krystiana Rizo and has been open since November 2020. The couple was born and raised in San Antonio, Texas, and their menu is inspired by their South Texas roots.

bio.description: Manhatta is a modern New American restaurant located sixty floors above the bustling streets of New York City, offering breathtaking views and an atmosphere that embodies the vibrant spirit of the city. The restaurant features an ever-evolving menu that highlights the versatility of local ingredients, providing guests with a dining experience that is both familiar and inventive, whether they choose to dine in the elegant dining room or the lively bar.
bio.culinary_style: Manhatta focuses on New American cuisine, offering a multi-course dinner and a la carte lunch options. The menu is crafted with traditional techniques and global influences, complemented by an award-winning wine list and a thoughtfully curated prix-fixe food menu.
bio.history: Manhatta is a restaurant from Danny Meyer's Union Square Hospitality Group.

bio.description: Tsukimi is a refined dining establishment located in the vibrant East Village, specializing in a modern interpretation of kaiseki, a traditional multi-course Japanese dinner. The name Tsukimi, meaning 'moon viewing', reflects the restaurant's dedication to celebrating seasonal ingredients and the beauty of nature, particularly during the mid-autumn harvest festival. With an intimate setting of only 12 seats, guests are invited to experience a thoughtfully curated tasting menu that evolves with the seasons, complemented by a selection of premium beverages.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant focuses on kaiseki cuisine, offering a seasonal tasting menu that showcases the artistry of Japanese culinary traditions. Signature techniques include meticulous ingredient selection and presentation, with an emphasis on fresh, high-quality components. The dining experience is enhanced by an optional sake and wine pairing curated by a passionate beverage team.
bio.history: Chef Takanori Akiyama leads the culinary team at Tsukimi, bringing expertise and creativity to the modern kaiseki experience.

bio.description: Chola Coastal Indian Cuisine is a timeless classic located in the upscale Upper East Side of New York City, celebrated for its authentic Indian flavors and chic ambiance. With a legacy spanning 26 years, the restaurant embodies a commitment to culinary excellence and Indian hospitality, ensuring that every guest feels revered. The dining experience is enriched by a thoughtfully curated wine list and a cocktail program designed to complement the vibrant menu.
bio.culinary_style: Chola specializes in authentic Indian cuisine, with a focus on traditional recipes and innovative dishes. The menu features a variety of house-made spice blends, chutneys, and sauces, highlighting the rich tapestry of Indian flavors. Signature techniques include the meticulous preparation of each dish from scratch, ensuring a unique and memorable dining experience.
bio.history: Chola was founded by Shiva Natarajan, a pioneer of the Indian dining scene in New York City, and is currently owned by his protégé, Min Bhujel. Shiva remains involved in menu development, having recently added 25 new dishes inspired by his travels in India.

bio.description: Maison Passerelle offers a fine dining experience that seamlessly blends classic French cuisine with modern techniques, set against a backdrop of stunning architectural design. Located in the heart of New York City's Financial District, the restaurant features an ambiance enriched by soaring frescoes and luminous stained glass, creating a transportive dining atmosphere that connects the elegance of fine dining with a vibrant downtown edge.
bio.culinary_style: Under the direction of Chef Gregory Gourdet, Maison Passerelle focuses on modern French cuisine inspired by the French diaspora. The menu showcases a variety of distinctive dining experiences, emphasizing vibrant flavors and refined techniques, with a commitment to using sustainable ingredients.
bio.history: Chef Gregory Gourdet, an award-winning chef and restaurateur, leads the culinary vision at Maison Passerelle. He is classically trained and has a rich background in the culinary arts, having worked with renowned chefs and opened several acclaimed restaurants.

bio.description: Shabushabu Mayumon offers a unique dining experience centered around shabu-shabu, transitioning from an Omakase-style service to a more personalized DIY approach. Guests are invited to explore a variety of premium ingredients and handcrafted sauces, allowing for a customizable and interactive meal that emphasizes quality and flavor. The restaurant's inviting atmosphere encourages relaxation and enjoyment, complemented by a curated selection of sake and wine.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant specializes in shabu-shabu, featuring high-quality A5 Miyazaki Wagyu Ribeye and seasonal vegetables. The menu allows for a DIY experience with a choice of seven handcrafted sauces and artisanal cheeses, enhancing the depth of flavors. Signature techniques include house-made sauces and a focus on customizable pairings.
bio.history: For the past six years, Shabushabu Mayumon has been serving the world's only Omakase-style shabu-shabu, evolving its concept to enhance guest interaction and choice.

bio.description: Santi is a stylish Italian restaurant located in Midtown East, NYC, helmed by world-renowned and Michelin-starred Chef Michael White. The restaurant offers a pan-Italian menu that reflects Chef White's extensive culinary journey, drawing inspiration from his experiences in Imola, the Amalfi coast, and the South of France. With a commitment to beautifully crafted cuisine, Santi provides an elegant dining atmosphere that emphasizes simplicity and inspiration in every dish.
bio.culinary_style: Santi specializes in Italian coastal cuisine, featuring a pan-Italian menu that showcases seasonal ingredients and traditional techniques. The dining experience includes both a la carte and prix fixe options, allowing guests to explore a variety of dishes that highlight the essence of Italian culinary artistry.
bio.history: Chef Michael White, a titan of the NYC food scene, has earned numerous accolades, including six Michelin stars and multiple James Beard nominations. Santi represents his latest endeavor in a long and celebrated culinary career.

bio.description: Cafe Commerce is an upscale neighborhood restaurant that embodies the philosophy of bistronomy, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere for both regulars and newcomers. With an intimate setting featuring 15 carefully arranged tables, the restaurant aims to be a hidden gem, providing a relaxed dining experience enhanced by exceptional cuisine and genuine hospitality. The menu reflects a unique blend of American cuisine crafted in the French tradition, complemented by cleverly crafted cocktails and a curated selection of wines.
bio.culinary_style: Cafe Commerce focuses on bistronomy, merging the vibrant spirit of New York City with the soulful essence of France. The menu features American cuisine prepared in the French tradition, with an emphasis on small, well-executed dishes.
bio.history: Established in 2024, Cafe Commerce was founded by Chef Harold Moore, Managing Partner Charles Pouchot, and Business Partner Patrick Corbett, drawing on their extensive experience in the culinary field. Chef Harold Moore has a distinguished career, having worked in renowned kitchens and earned accolades including a Michelin star.

bio.description: Massara is a refined dining establishment located in New York City, dedicated to the authentic regional cuisine of Campania. The restaurant embodies a warm and inviting atmosphere, reminiscent of a familial gathering, where guests can enjoy a thoughtfully curated menu inspired by Chef Stefano Secchi's childhood memories of Southern Italy. With a focus on seamless service and a commitment to providing an exceptional dining experience, Massara invites patrons to indulge in the rich flavors and culinary traditions of the Campanian region.
bio.culinary_style: Massara specializes in Campanian cuisine, featuring dishes that highlight the region's abundant farms and fisheries. The menu is crafted around cooking techniques utilizing a wood-burning oven and grill, offering a unique and flavorful dining experience.
bio.history: Massara, meaning 'matriarch' and 'head of the household' in Campanian dialect, draws inspiration from Chef Stefano Secchi’s childhood memories of visiting Southern Italy.

bio.description: Corima is a vibrant culinary destination in New York City that embodies the spirit of sharing and community, as suggested by its name, which translates to 'circle of sharing.' The restaurant showcases the rich culinary heritage of northern Mexico, particularly the states of Sonora and Chihuahua, through a modern lens. With a focus on both traditional and innovative techniques, Corima offers a unique dining experience that celebrates the flavors of Mexico while incorporating local Northeast ingredients.
bio.culinary_style: Corima specializes in Progressive Mexican cuisine, blending traditional recipes with contemporary techniques. The menu features a diverse array of dishes that highlight a wide Mexican pantry, complemented by local ingredients. Signature techniques are influenced by Chef Fidel Caballero's experiences in Basque Country and his culinary roots in Ciudad Juárez and El Paso.
bio.history: Chef Fidel Caballero, inspired by his upbringing and culinary experiences, opened Corima to represent northern Mexico in New York's dining scene. Within a year of opening, the restaurant received a Michelin star and was recognized as one of Bon Appetit's Best New Restaurants of 2024.

bio.description: See No Evil Pizza is a vibrant dining destination located in a subway station in Times Square, New York City, exuding an 80s punk vibe. The restaurant offers a laid-back atmosphere where guests can enjoy iconic thin-crust pizzas alongside flavorful small plates, making it an ideal spot for both casual dining and special events.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant specializes in thin-crust pizzas, featuring unique offerings such as the spicy Hell Pie. The menu also includes small plates like sardine toast and seasonal beans in walnut sauce, with a signature dessert of vanilla soft serve topped with olive oil and sea salt.

bio.description: Jua is a unique Korean wood-fired restaurant that offers an intimate dining experience, showcasing the artistry of Chef Hoyoung Kim. The ambiance reflects a blend of modern elegance and traditional Korean elements, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for guests to enjoy a thoughtfully curated meal.
bio.culinary_style: Jua specializes in Korean cuisine, utilizing various wood-fire techniques to enhance the flavors of each dish. The restaurant features an original 7-course tasting menu that highlights seasonal ingredients and Chef Kim's culinary expertise.
bio.history: Jua is the creation of Chef Hoyoung Kim, a former executive chef of the two-Michelin-starred restaurant Jungsik. The restaurant is named after his firstborn daughter, Jua, which signifies 'joie' in French.

bio.description: J.G. Melon is a quintessential New York City dining establishment located on the Upper East Side, renowned for its vibrant atmosphere and rich history since 1972. The restaurant embodies a classic saloon vibe, featuring Melon decor, green and white tablecloths, and an old-time jukebox, creating a nostalgic yet lively dining experience that attracts both locals and visitors alike, including celebrities and families.
bio.culinary_style: J.G. Melon specializes in classic American cuisine, with a particular focus on their famously juicy hamburgers and cottage fries. The menu is straightforward, emphasizing quality ingredients and traditional preparation methods, ensuring a memorable burger experience.
bio.history: J.G. Melon has been serving its loyal clientele since 1972, developing a strong following from the very beginning.

bio.description: Don Antonio is a celebrated Neapolitan pizzeria located in the vibrant heart of Midtown Manhattan, specifically in Hell’s Kitchen and the Theatre District. The restaurant prides itself on delivering authentic Neapolitan pizza, crafted in a traditional wood-fired oven, ensuring a genuine taste of Naples. With a casual, welcoming atmosphere, Don Antonio offers a diverse menu that includes classic pizzas, unique pizza fritta, and a selection of Italian craft beers and wines, making it a go-to destination for pizza enthusiasts.
bio.culinary_style: Don Antonio specializes in authentic Neapolitan pizza, featuring over 30 varieties crafted with high-quality Italian ingredients. The menu includes traditional pizzas and innovative pizza fritta, all available in gluten-free options. The pizzas are baked at 850°F in a wood-fired oven, achieving a perfect balance of crispness and softness.
bio.history: Founded in 2012 by renowned chefs Roberto Caporuscio and Antonio Starita, Don Antonio is now led by Giorgia Caporuscio, an award-winning master pizzaiola. Giorgia has received numerous accolades, including being named Pizza Maker of the Year by 50 Top Pizza USA in 2024.

bio.description: Bayon offers a captivating dining experience that transports guests to Cambodia through its vibrant aromas and warm hospitality. The restaurant's ambiance reflects the cultural splendor of Cambodia, creating a welcoming environment that invites diners to explore a menu that honors traditional Cambodian cuisine while incorporating innovative culinary techniques. With a focus on resilience and revival, Bayon stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of the Angkor era.
bio.culinary_style: Bayon specializes in Cambodian cuisine, blending classic recipes with contemporary culinary innovations. The menu features a variety of meticulously crafted dishes that highlight the use of aromatic spices such as lemongrass and galangal. The dining format encourages exploration of both traditional and modern interpretations of Cambodian flavors.
bio.history: Bayon emerged from the challenges of the pandemic, evolving from its predecessor, Angkor Cambodian Bistro, to offer a renewed culinary experience.

bio.description: Che Li is a distinguished Chinese restaurant located in the heart of New York, offering a unique dining experience that intertwines the rich cultural heritage of the Song Dynasty with the sophisticated flavors of Shanghai cuisine. The restaurant's ambiance reflects a harmonious blend of historical elegance and contemporary sophistication, creating an immersive environment that transports diners to an era celebrated for its artistic and culinary achievements. Each meal at Che Li is designed to be a visually captivating and gastronomically rewarding experience, celebrating the communal spirit of traditional feasts.
bio.culinary_style: Che Li specializes in Shanghai cuisine, focusing on the delicate flavors and meticulous preparation characteristic of Jiangnan culinary traditions. The menu features signature dishes such as Beggar's Chicken and Braised Pork Belly, presented with an emphasis on elegant presentation and storytelling. The dining format encourages communal sharing, reminiscent of traditional banquet culture.
bio.history: This summer marks the 10th year of operation for Che Li, which has successfully transformed family recipes into a beloved dining destination in New York.

bio.description: Dagon is a modern Israeli restaurant located in the heart of the Upper West Side of Manhattan, celebrated for its vibrant interpretation of Levantine cuisine. With a warm and inviting atmosphere reminiscent of Tel Aviv, the restaurant features vintage decor and a cozy ambiance that embodies the spirit of 'la dolce vita.' Dagon aims to be a culinary voice of peace, drawing inspiration from the Mediterranean and offering a unique dining experience that combines cultural heritage with contemporary flair.
bio.culinary_style: Dagon specializes in modern Israeli cuisine, focusing on flavors from across the Mediterranean. The menu features a variety of dishes inspired by the diverse cultures of the Levant, including signature items like Harissa BBQ Chicken and Whole Roasted Branzino. The restaurant also offers a creative cocktail list and an award-winning wine selection.
bio.history: Dagon was founded by restaurateur Simon Oren and partner David Sasson, inspired by the former Dutch cargo vessel MV Peace, which broadcast from the Middle East. Executive Chef Ari Bokovza, drawing on his Tunisian and Israeli heritage, leads the kitchen.

bio.description: Cho Dang Gol is a renowned Korean restaurant located in New York City, celebrated for its dedication to homemade tofu dishes. Since its establishment in 1997, the restaurant has cultivated a warm and inviting atmosphere, where guests can enjoy a variety of traditional and creatively inspired Korean meals. Each dining experience begins with a complimentary tofu starter, setting the stage for a culinary journey that emphasizes freshness and authenticity.
bio.culinary_style: Cho Dang Gol specializes in homemade tofu-based dishes, showcasing the versatility of this key ingredient. The menu features a blend of traditional Korean fare alongside innovative recipes, with weekly and seasonal specials that invite exploration of diverse flavors.
bio.history: Cho Dang Gol has been serving the community since 1997, establishing itself as a 'Tofu House' with a commitment to quality and freshness.

bio.description: The Lobster Club is a glamorously laidback Japanese restaurant located in Midtown Manhattan, designed by renowned architect Peter Marino. This modern dining establishment revives the vibrant spirit of its predecessor, The Brasserie, offering a unique atmosphere that blends sophistication with a relaxed vibe. The menu features deeply satisfying interpretations of Japanese classics, encouraging a communal dining experience with beautifully crafted dishes and an extensive selection of cocktails, sakes, and wines.
bio.culinary_style: The Lobster Club specializes in modern Japanese cuisine, offering a wide-ranging menu that includes gyoza, yakitori, and katsu-style wagyu sandos. Each dish is designed for sharing and is complemented by an extravagant array of sauces, with sushi prepared from fish flown in daily from Tokyo’s Toyosu market.
bio.history: Founded by Jeff Zalaznick, Chef Mario Carbone, and Chef Rich Torrisi, Major Food Group has been delivering celebrated culinary experiences for over a decade.

bio.description: Laliko is a charming Georgian restaurant located in the heart of New York City, offering an authentic dining experience steeped in tradition and warmth. The restaurant's cozy atmosphere is complemented by beautiful wall murals and a welcoming staff, many of whom are authentically from Georgia. Guests can expect a delightful culinary journey through Georgia's rich flavors, with a menu that features both classic and modern interpretations of Georgian cuisine.
bio.culinary_style: Laliko specializes in traditional Georgian dishes, including khinkali (dumplings) and khachapuri (cheese bread), showcasing bold flavors and rich textures. The menu is designed to highlight centuries-old recipes while incorporating thoughtful modern touches, and the restaurant offers a well-curated selection of Georgian wines to enhance the dining experience.
bio.history: The restaurant opened about a year ago and has quickly gained recognition for its authentic cuisine and warm hospitality.

bio.description: Markette is a Modern European restaurant infused with Caribbean influences, located in the vibrant Chelsea neighborhood of New York City. The restaurant offers an elegant yet welcoming atmosphere, perfect for romantic dinners, celebrations, and pre-show dining. With a focus on seasonal dishes and creative cocktails, Markette provides a refined dining experience that emphasizes comfort and connection among guests.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus at Markette blends refined European techniques with vibrant Caribbean flavors. The menu is designed for sharing and features an ever-evolving selection of inventive plates and inspired flavor pairings. Signature techniques include a thoughtful composition of dishes that balance comfort and creativity.
bio.history: Markette is an intimate dinner destination created by Chef India Doris and hospitality veteran Alex Pfaffenbach, reflecting Chef India's experiences cooking throughout Europe and her Caribbean heritage.

bio.description: Ly Ly Vietnam Cookhouse offers a vibrant and inviting atmosphere that celebrates the rich flavors of Vietnamese cuisine. With a focus on creating memorable dining experiences, the restaurant combines traditional dishes with a modern twist, making it a perfect spot for both casual meals and special occasions.

bio.description: La Tête d’Or is a sophisticated dining establishment that pays homage to timeless flavors and traditions, seamlessly blending American and French culinary influences. bio.description: Katz's Delicatessen, established in 1888, is New York City's oldest deli and a cherished institution in the heart of the Lower East Side. Renowned for its vibrant atmosphere and rich history, Katz's offers a quintessential New York dining experience, where locals and tourists alike gather to enjoy classic deli fare. The restaurant's walls are adorned with photographs of famous patrons, reflecting its longstanding connection to the cultural fabric of the city.
bio.culinary_style: Katz's specializes in traditional Jewish deli cuisine, focusing on high-quality meats such as pastrami, corned beef, and brisket. The menu features classic items like the iconic pastrami sandwich and matzoh ball soup, with a commitment to slow curing methods that enhance flavor without additives. The deli operates in a casual format, allowing guests to enjoy their meals on-site or through nationwide shipping.
bio.history: Katz's Delicatessen was originally founded as Iceland Brothers in 1888 and was renamed after Willy Katz joined in 1903. The deli has been family-run for over a century, with significant ownership transitions leading to its current management. The establishment has become a cultural landmark, known for its slogan 'Send A Salami To Your Boy In The Army' during World War II and its role as a gathering place for the Yiddish theater community.

Le Coucou marks his first restaurant in the United States, in collaboration with restaurateur Stephen Starr.

bio.history: Miss Lily's has been serving modern Caribbean cooking for over 15 years, with a culinary team that includes Chef Brittney 'Stikxz' Williams, who has experience in Michelin-starred restaurants, and Chef Andre Fowles, a three-time Food Network Chopped Champion. The restaurant draws inspiration from the diverse roots of Jamaican cuisine.

bio.description: Fasano Restaurant, located in the heart of New York City, embodies a century of Milanese gastronomy, offering a timeless setting for both lunch and dinner. The restaurant is characterized by its traditional hospitality and authentic Milanese cuisine, creating a classic fine-dining experience that is refined yet approachable. With an elegant atmosphere and a commitment to quality, Fasano serves as a beacon of the family’s long-standing tradition in fine Italian dining.
bio.culinary_style: Fasano specializes in elevated Northern Italian cuisine, focusing on classic Milanese dishes. The menu features a selection of signature items such as Ossobuco alla Menighina con Risotto alla Milanese and Tortelli di Vitello con Fonduta di Parmigiano Reggiano. The dining experience is complemented by an award-winning wine list.
bio.history: Fasano's gastronomic history began in 1902 when Vittorio Fasano opened an outpost named 'Brasserie Paulista' in São Paulo. Gero Fasano, the fourth generation of the Fasano restaurateurs, joined the business in the 1980s and has since expanded the brand to include 30 restaurants and 10 hotels across Brazil, the United States, and Uruguay. The New York location stands as a testament to the family's commitment to excellence and Italian heritage.

bio.description: Carlotto is a modern urban trattoria located in the heart of Union Square, New York, designed by the award-winning Rockwell Group. The restaurant offers an intimate dining experience that celebrates Italy’s most celebrated regions, featuring a stunning bar with a curated cocktail list and an extensive selection of amaro and Italian wines.
bio.culinary_style: Carlotto focuses on authentic Italian cuisine, with an emphasis on handmade pastas prepared daily. The menu is designed to reflect the diverse culinary traditions of Italy, offering a blend of classic and contemporary dishes.
bio.history: Carlotto is part of Vancouver’s award-winning Toptable Group, which has been defining elegant yet approachable dining for over four decades. Executive Chef Andy Kitko leads the culinary vision for the restaurant.

bio.description: The Commerce Inn is an early American tavern and cookery located in the heart of the West Village, New York City. With a focus on craftsmanship and heirloom recipes, the restaurant offers a warm and inviting atmosphere that celebrates seasonal cooking and material honesty. The interior design pays homage to the architecture of the early 1900s, creating a space that feels both historic and welcoming, perfect for enjoying straightforward fare and expertly crafted cocktails.
bio.culinary_style: The Commerce Inn specializes in American cookery, featuring a menu inspired by heritage recipes. Dishes include piquant pickled oysters, comforting rarebit, and fortifying pot pies, all prepared simply and served casually. The restaurant also offers a selection of deftly crafted cocktails and a curated wine list highlighting small American producers.
bio.history: The Commerce Inn has been welcoming guests for almost a century and is brought to life by esteemed New York chefs Rita Sodi and Jody Williams.

bio.description: Semma is a vibrant culinary destination that showcases the rich traditions of Southern Indian cuisine, particularly from Tamil Nadu. The restaurant, a creation of the Unapologetic Foods team, offers a unique dining experience that emphasizes bold flavors and regional ingredients, inviting guests to explore the depth of South Indian culinary heritage. With a commitment to authenticity and a focus on family recipes, Semma provides a memorable journey through the tastes and aromas of Southern India.
bio.culinary_style: Semma specializes in Southern Indian cuisine, with a menu that features a variety of dishes inspired by the traditions of Tamil Nadu. The restaurant offers a diverse selection of small plates and larger entrees, highlighting signature techniques such as the use of layered spices and regional ingredients.
bio.history: Brought to life by Chef Vijay Kumar, Semma is part of the Unapologetic Foods group, which includes notable establishments like Dhamaka and Adda.

bio.description: Carne Mare is an Italian chophouse located in the vibrant Seaport District of New York City, helmed by renowned Chef Andrew Carmellini. The restaurant offers a sophisticated dining experience with stunning views of the Manhattan waterfront and the Brooklyn Bridge, featuring a two-story space designed by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio. Guests can enjoy a blend of prime cuts of steak, fine seafood, and traditional Italian specialties in a stylish setting that includes both indoor and outdoor seating, a wrap-around bar, and a wood-fired oven.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus at Carne Mare centers on prime-aged beef, including wagyu and prime rib, complemented by housemade pastas and a selection of seafood. The menu features a variety of Italian specialties, traditional antipasti, and a selection of steakhouse contorni, creating a well-rounded dining experience.
bio.history: Carne Mare is led by Chef Andrew Carmellini and Chef della Cucina Dwight Sanon.

bio.description: Veerays, NYC's first Indian speakeasy restaurant, offers a unique dining experience that combines the charm of the Prohibition era with the rich flavors of Indian cuisine. Under the guidance of Michelin-starred Chef Hemant Mathur, the restaurant presents a menu that features regional classics, exotic grills, and modern interpretations of traditional dishes, all set in an ambiance that exudes old-world elegance and sophistication.
bio.culinary_style: Veerays specializes in Indian cuisine, showcasing a menu that includes regional classics and innovative twists. The dining format emphasizes a blend of traditional and contemporary techniques, with a focus on exotic grills and signature cocktails inspired by the 1920s.
bio.history: Veerays is the latest venture of Chef Hemant Mathur, the first Indian chef in the U.S. to earn a Michelin star. This marks his fifth restaurant in the New York/CT area and the third in New York City, reflecting his dedication to elevating Indian culinary arts.

bio.description: Oceans is a seafood restaurant that embodies a blend of local and global influences, offering a timeless and approachable dining experience. Located in the heart of New York City, the restaurant features a menu crafted by Executive Chef Andy Kitko, showcasing the freshest seafood from the Pacific, Atlantic, and Mediterranean shores, complemented by seasonal ingredients. The ambiance is designed to be elegant yet welcoming, making it an ideal destination for both casual diners and special occasions.
bio.culinary_style: Oceans specializes in seafood, sushi, and a raw bar experience. The menu is inspired by various coastal cuisines and emphasizes the use of locally and globally sourced ingredients. Signature techniques include a focus on simplicity and freshness, allowing the natural flavors of the seafood to shine.
bio.history: Founded by Vancouver’s award-winning Toptable Group, Oceans is led by Executive Chef Andy Kitko, who has a rich background in esteemed kitchens and Michelin-starred restaurants. Kitko's passion for seafood-focused cuisine was honed during his tenure at New York’s Estiatorio Milos.

bio.description: Dhamaka is an Unapologetic Foods restaurant that immerses diners in the rich, bold flavors of India's forgotten culinary traditions. Nestled in Essex Market on the Lower East Side, the restaurant showcases regional dishes that are often overlooked, offering an authentic experience that is both intensely spiced and deeply rooted in memory. Dhamaka invites guests to explore the powerful stories behind these dishes, creating a dining atmosphere that is unapologetically vibrant and culturally rich.
bio.culinary_style: Dhamaka focuses on the provincial cooking of India, emphasizing regional dishes that are rarely seen outside of Indian homes and roadside stalls. The menu features a variety of intensely spiced offerings, including a selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, and highlights signature techniques such as slow braising and grilling.
bio.history: Dhamaka is part of Unapologetic Foods and aims to celebrate the forgotten side of Indian cuisine.

bio.description: Tha Phraya is a vibrant culinary destination that celebrates the rich flavors and memories of Thai cuisine. With a focus on high-quality ingredients and authentic family recipes, the restaurant offers a dining experience that is both visually appealing and deeply rooted in tradition. Guests can expect a warm atmosphere that invites them to explore the diverse tastes of Thailand, making it a must-visit for food lovers.
bio.culinary_style: Tha Phraya specializes in traditional Thai cuisine, emphasizing the use of fresh, high-quality ingredients. The menu features a variety of dishes that highlight the complex flavors of Thai cooking, including sweet, salty, sour, and spicy elements. Signature dishes like 'Miang-kum' showcase the restaurant's commitment to authentic flavors and presentation.
bio.history: Tha Phraya was founded by a group of Thai restaurateurs and chefs who share a passion for the culinary heritage of Thailand.

bio.description: Portale is a contemporary Italian restaurant located in the heart of New York City's Chelsea neighborhood. The restaurant, housed in a beautifully renovated carriage house, offers a relaxed and convivial atmosphere, perfect for enjoying a thoughtfully crafted dining experience. With a focus on seasonal ingredients and a modern Italian flair, Portale aims to delight guests with its inviting ambiance and stylish decor, designed to provide both comfort and sophistication.
bio.culinary_style: Portale specializes in contemporary Italian cuisine, showcasing a menu that features an abundance of roasted vegetables, market salads, pastas, and assorted grilled meats and fish. The culinary approach is inspired by Italy's seasonally driven cooking traditions, emphasizing fresh and high-quality ingredients.
bio.history: Chef Alfred Portale, the Executive Chef and Owner, brings his heritage and passion for Italian cuisine to the restaurant, creating a menu that reflects his dedication to the culture and flavors of Italy.

bio.description: Farra is an intimate neighborhood wine bar that embodies a warm and inviting atmosphere, seating just 22 guests. Located in close proximity to its sister restaurant Atera, Farra focuses on bringing people together through a carefully curated selection of wines and a diverse a la carte menu, perfect for light snacks or shared dinners among friends.
bio.culinary_style: Farra specializes in a contemporary a la carte dining experience, featuring a menu that highlights seasonal ingredients. The culinary offerings include dishes such as Halibut Ravioli and Dry Aged Ribeye, complemented by an evolving selection of wines curated by the wine director.
bio.history: Farra is a sister restaurant to Atera, inspired by the Basque word meaning 'to drink', which reflects its mission to foster community through shared beverages.

bio.description: Szechuan Gourmet 39 offers a vibrant dining experience that celebrates the rich and dynamic flavors of Szechuan cuisine. With nearly 20 years of culinary expertise, the restaurant prides itself on delivering high-quality, handmade meals that evoke the warmth and nostalgia of traditional Sichuan culture. The inviting atmosphere and commitment to accessibility ensure that guests from all walks of life can enjoy the robust and full-bodied flavors that define this beloved cuisine.
bio.culinary_style: Szechuan Gourmet 39 specializes in authentic Szechuan cuisine, focusing on bold, spicy flavors and intricate dishes. The menu features a variety of options, including signature dishes like Spicy Lamb Pot and Smoky Wok-Tossed Chicken with Roasted Chili. The restaurant employs traditional cooking techniques that highlight the unique characteristics of Szechuan ingredients, particularly the use of red pepper.
bio.history: The restaurant has nearly 20 years of experience and has gained recognition from esteemed culinary platforms, including a spot on the Michelin Bib Gourmand list.

bio.description: Saga is a premier dining destination located in a historic Art Deco tower at 70 Pine Street, offering breathtaking views of the New York skyline. Since its opening in 2021, the restaurant has garnered critical acclaim, including two Michelin stars, for its innovative approach to fine dining. Under the leadership of Executive Chef Charlie Mitchell, Saga provides an intimate and sophisticated atmosphere where each multi-course tasting menu is a narrative of emotion and culinary craftsmanship.
bio.culinary_style: Saga specializes in a multi-course tasting menu that emphasizes bold yet refined flavors. The cuisine is inspired by a blend of nostalgia and classic techniques, utilizing humble ingredients elevated to new heights. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted to tell a unique story.
bio.history: Opened in 2021 by Chef Jamal James Kent, Saga has maintained its Michelin two-star status since its first year. Chef Charlie Mitchell became the Executive Chef in July 2024, continuing the restaurant's legacy of pushing culinary boundaries.

bio.description: Eléa is an upscale Greek restaurant located on the Upper West Side of New York City, designed to evoke the ambiance of a romantic island getaway. With its open split-level layout adorned with traditional Grecian pottery and a cozy Mediterranean aesthetic, Eléa offers a warm and inviting dining experience that caters to both casual diners and those seeking a more formal meal. The restaurant's atmosphere is enhanced by soft lighting and a contemporary decor that reflects the essence of Greek culture.
bio.culinary_style: Eléa specializes in modern Greek cuisine, focusing on bold flavors derived from seasonal ingredients. The menu features approachable dishes, including seafood and meat preparations, as well as a variety of traditional spreads known as Pikilia. Signature offerings include Tuna Tartare, Octopus, and a selection of daily whole fish.
bio.history: Meaning 'olive' in ancient Greek, Eléa aims to blend true Greek cuisine with a modern twist, creating a unique dining experience that reflects the diverse flavors of Greece's many islands.

bio.description: Orsay is an iconic Upper East Side French restaurant that embodies the charm of a classic Parisian brasserie. With its sophisticated yet warm ambiance, the restaurant features dark mahogany paneling, Art Nouveau arches, and elegant chandeliers, creating a refined dining experience. Guests can enjoy a sidewalk terrace that enhances the Parisian feel, making it a perfect spot for everyday dining.
bio.culinary_style: Orsay specializes in modern French cuisine combined with classic brasserie fare. The menu is complemented by an award-winning wine list featuring 225 predominantly French and American varietals. The dining format emphasizes a balance of traditional and contemporary techniques.

bio.description: HanGawi is a serene Korean restaurant located in the heart of Manhattan, offering a unique dining experience that transcends mere sustenance. Since its inception in 1994, the restaurant has provided a tranquil sanctuary where guests can immerse themselves in the rich traditions of Korean plant-based cuisine. The ambiance is designed to promote calmness and mindfulness, featuring low tables, warm wooden floors, and muted lighting that encourages diners to savor each moment.
bio.culinary_style: HanGawi specializes in Korean plant-based cuisine, focusing on harmony with nature through the use of root vegetables, mountain greens, heirloom grains, and herbal infusions. The menu features signature dishes such as sizzling stone bowls and hand-wrapped ssam bap, all prepared with intention to nourish and uplift.
bio.history: Since 1994, Hangawi has offered more than just a meal, welcoming guests into a quiet sanctuary rooted in the deep traditions of Korean plant-based cuisine.

bio.description: Gallaghers Steakhouse, a historic dining establishment located in the heart of New York City and recently expanded to Boca Raton, offers a quintessential steakhouse experience steeped in nearly a century of tradition. Known for its vibrant atmosphere, adorned with memorabilia of Broadway stars and sports legends, Gallaghers provides a unique blend of classic charm and modern elegance, making it a favored destination for both locals and visitors alike.
bio.culinary_style: Gallaghers specializes in prime steaks, expertly aged and grilled to perfection. The menu features a classic steakhouse format, with an emphasis on high-quality cuts and traditional accompaniments, ensuring a memorable dining experience. Signature techniques include dry-aging beef in their iconic meat locker, enhancing the flavor and tenderness of their steaks.
bio.history: Gallaghers opened in 1927 as a speakeasy during Prohibition and transformed into Broadway's first steakhouse after the repeal of Prohibition in 1933. Over the years, it has been owned and operated by notable figures, including Helen Gallagher and Jack Solomon, and has undergone several renovations to preserve its legacy. In 2013, Dean Poll acquired Gallaghers with the vision of restoring its status as a premier steakhouse, and in 2023, a second location was opened in Boca Raton.

bio.description: Masa is a culinary destination in New York City, helmed by acclaimed chef Masayoshi Takayama. The restaurant embodies the philosophy of shibui, where tradition meets artistry, and every detail reflects a dedication to craft and precision. With a minimalistic decor that serves as a blank canvas, the dining experience is designed to highlight the purity and character of each ingredient, creating an immersive and elevated omakase experience.
bio.culinary_style: Masa specializes in traditional Japanese cuisine, focusing on an omakase format that showcases seasonal ingredients at their peak freshness. Chef Masa employs precision and creativity in his techniques, ensuring that each dish maintains the innate character of its components.
bio.history: Chef Masa Takayama is renowned for his precision and creativity, bringing together traditional Japanese techniques and modern artistry.

bio.description: Café Sabarsky offers a refined dining experience inspired by the iconic Viennese cafés of 20th century Austria. Located within the Neue Galerie New York, the café is adorned with period furnishings and art, creating an atmosphere that reflects the intellectual and artistic vibrancy of its historical roots. Guests can enjoy a blend of culinary excellence and cultural performances, including cabaret and classical music, in a setting that is both elegant and inviting.
bio.culinary_style: Café Sabarsky specializes in elevated Austrian cuisine, featuring a menu that includes breakfast, lunch, and dinner options. The dining experience is complemented by a three-course dinner served during cabaret performances, showcasing the restaurant's commitment to both culinary artistry and cultural heritage.
bio.history: Café Sabarsky is named after Serge Sabarsky, co-founder of the Neue Galerie New York, and has been a distinguished dining destination for two decades under the direction of Executive Chef Christopher Engel.

bio.description: COTE Korean Steakhouse is America’s first and only Michelin-starred Korean Steakhouse, renowned for its unique blend of Korean barbeque and classic American steakhouse elements. The restaurant offers a vibrant and interactive dining experience, where guests can enjoy the highest quality USDA Prime beef in a convivial atmosphere, complemented by an extensive wine list and creative cocktails.
bio.culinary_style: COTE specializes in Korean barbeque with a focus on USDA Prime and American Wagyu beef. The menu features a combination of grilled steak and innovative cocktails, creating a dynamic dining experience. The restaurant emphasizes an interactive format, allowing guests to engage in the cooking process.

bio.description: Upland is a sophisticated brasserie that embodies a California-inspired culinary philosophy, harmonizing rustic charm with a global perspective. The restaurant features a dynamic yet intimate atmosphere, characterized by handsome natural wood and lush leather, creating a welcoming environment for diners. With an open kitchen that showcases the artistry of its culinary team, Upland offers a thoughtfully crafted menu that highlights seasonal American dishes, wood-fired pizzas, and house-made pastas, all complemented by a curated wine list.
bio.culinary_style: Upland focuses on seasonal American cuisine with a California influence, offering a diverse menu that includes wood-fired pizzas and house-made pastas. The dining experience is enhanced by a food-friendly wine list and a selection of smart by-the-glass options.

bio.description: Avant Garden is a celebrated modern vegan restaurant located in the East Village of New York City, known for its decade-long commitment to plant-based artistry. The restaurant offers a refined and heartfelt dining experience, showcasing the beauty and complexity of vegetables in a warm and inviting atmosphere.
bio.culinary_style: Avant Garden focuses on innovative plant-based cuisine, emphasizing fresh, natural vegetables and global flavors. The menu features a variety of beloved vegan dishes paired with curated selections of natural wines, creating a unique and memorable dining experience.
bio.history: Founded in 2015 by CEO & Founder Ravi DeRossi, Avant Garden has served as a blueprint for his plant-based hospitality group, Overthrow Hospitality. The restaurant has quickly become a staple in New York's vegan dining scene.

bio.description: Crown Shy is a Michelin-starred restaurant located in the historic Art Deco building at 70 Pine Street in Manhattan’s Financial District. This neighborhood establishment combines fine dining techniques with a warm, friendly service, creating an inviting atmosphere for guests. The restaurant's design and ambiance reflect a modern yet classic aesthetic, making it a perfect spot for both casual dining and special occasions.
bio.culinary_style: Crown Shy focuses on a menu rooted in European culinary techniques while drawing inspiration from global flavors, particularly those reminiscent of childhood and the diverse culinary landscape of New York City. The restaurant offers a thoughtfully curated menu that showcases seasonal ingredients and innovative cooking methods.
bio.history: Crown Shy opened in 2019 and was awarded a Michelin star just six months after its debut, maintaining this prestigious recognition every year since.

bio.description: Tolo is a vibrant dining destination located in New York City, offering a unique blend of traditional Chinese cuisine and contemporary dining aesthetics. The restaurant features an open kitchen and vintage furniture, creating an inviting atmosphere for guests to enjoy a diverse menu that ranges from raw seafood to comforting rice and noodle dishes, all complemented by a carefully curated wine list of over 300 selections.
bio.culinary_style: Tolo specializes in modern Chinese cuisine, showcasing a variety of dishes that highlight fresh ingredients and bold flavors. The menu includes options such as raw seafood, rice, noodles, and signature dishes like sweet & sour crispy fish, presented in a casual yet refined format.
bio.history: Tolo is helmed by Chef Ron Yan, who has spent the past decade immersed in New York City's culinary scene.

bio.description: The Dining Room at The Guesthouse offers a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. With a focus on providing an exceptional dining experience, the restaurant features a beautifully designed space that complements its upscale menu and attentive service.
bio.culinary_style: The Dining Room specializes in a diverse menu that includes breakfast and weekend brunch options served all day. The culinary focus is on high-quality ingredients and seasonal flavors, ensuring a fresh and delightful dining experience.

bio.description: Little Myanmar is a vibrant Burmese restaurant located in the heart of New York City, offering an authentic taste of Myanmar's rich culinary heritage. The restaurant provides a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both casual dining and special occasions, where guests can enjoy a unique blend of flavors and traditional dishes.
bio.culinary_style: Little Myanmar specializes in Burmese cuisine, featuring a diverse menu that highlights the country's unique flavors and ingredients. The restaurant focuses on traditional recipes and cooking techniques, ensuring an authentic dining experience.

bio.description: Le Rock is a vibrant dining destination located in the heart of Rockefeller Center, offering a modern interpretation of a classic French brasserie. The restaurant is housed in a beautifully restored Art Deco space, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere that reflects both its historic roots and contemporary flair. With its prime location adjacent to iconic New York landmarks, Le Rock promises an exceptional dining experience that combines culinary excellence with a lively ambiance.
bio.culinary_style: Le Rock specializes in French cuisine, showcasing a menu that emphasizes high-quality ingredients and traditional techniques. The restaurant offers a diverse selection of dishes that highlight the essence of French culinary artistry, making it a perfect spot for both casual dining and special occasions.
bio.history: Le Rock is the creation of James Beard Award-winning chefs Lee Hanson and Riad Nasr, who are known for their work at some of Manhattan's best restaurants, including Frenchette and Le Veau d'Or.

bio.description: Jōji is a Michelin-starred restaurant located in the heart of Midtown’s One Vanderbilt, offering an intimate dining experience infused with authentic Japanese character. The serene atmosphere is designed to reflect a deep reverence for nature, creating a refined setting that inspires and delights guests. With a focus on personalized service, Jōji provides a sophisticated culinary journey that is both elegant and memorable.
bio.culinary_style: Jōji specializes in a traditional multi-course Omakase experience, where each meal is uniquely crafted for the guest using the finest seasonally available ingredients. The menu is complemented by premium sake and fine wine, enhancing the overall dining experience.
bio.history: The restaurant is led by Chef-partners George Ruan and Wayne S. Cheng, with dining operations overseen by Michelin-Starred Chef Daniel Boulud’s The Dinex Group. Jōji has been awarded a prestigious Michelin star.

bio.description: Tonchin is a celebrated ramen restaurant that originated in Tokyo, Japan, in 1992. With a mission to create a welcoming space for all, Tonchin has expanded from its humble beginnings to multiple locations, including a flagship in Midtown New York, a full-menu restaurant in Brooklyn, and a new site in Larchmont Village, LA. The restaurant embodies a spirit of community and connection, offering a unique dining experience centered around the art of ramen.
bio.culinary_style: Tonchin specializes in Tokyo-style ramen, particularly their signature Tokyo Tonkotsu broth, which is a lighter version of traditional pork broths. The menu features hand-kneaded, medium-thick noodles that are prepared fresh daily, ensuring optimal texture and flavor. The culinary approach emphasizes quality ingredients and innovative techniques to create a harmonious balance of flavors.
bio.history: Tonchin was founded by brothers Katsuhiro and Motohiro Sugeno, who were inspired by the evolving nature of ramen. After 25 years, Anan Sugeno expanded the brand to the global stage, continuing the legacy of experimentation and community connection.

bio.description: Tamarind Tribeca is a premier Indian restaurant located in the vibrant heart of Tribeca, NYC, offering an exquisite dining experience that marries traditional Indian flavors with contemporary elegance. Under the guidance of owner Mr. Avtar Walia, the restaurant aims to redefine the perception of Indian cuisine, presenting it in its purest form while embracing the sophistication of modern dining. Guests are invited to embark on a culinary journey that showcases the rich cultural diversity of India through artfully crafted dishes and an exceptional wine selection.
bio.culinary_style: Tamarind Tribeca specializes in authentic Indian cuisine, focusing on classical flavors presented with a modern sensibility. The menu features a variety of options, including a la carte selections and expertly paired wine offerings, designed to enhance the dining experience. Signature techniques include the use of traditional Indian cooking methods combined with innovative presentations.
bio.history: Mr. Avtar Walia, the owner, has a rich background in the culinary world, having previously co-owned the renowned restaurant Dawat and later opening the original Tamarind in Flatiron, which received a Michelin star. With the establishment of Tamarind Tribeca, he aims to elevate Indian cuisine within the fine dining landscape of New York.

bio.description: Marea is a modern and chic institution located in Central Park South, New York City, that redefines high-end coastal Italian cuisine. It attracts discerning diners who appreciate luxury and seek to elevate their dining experiences with exquisite food, unmatched service, and a vibrant atmosphere. Marea seamlessly blends the authentic flavors of coastal Italy with the dynamic style of New York, creating a unique culinary experience that celebrates life's moments.
bio.culinary_style: Marea specializes in coastal Italian cuisine, focusing on meticulously crafted pasta and seafood dishes. The menu features a combination of signature crudo and handmade pastas, presented in a tasting format that highlights the bracing flavors of the sea. The restaurant is known for its elegant presentation and high-quality ingredients.
bio.history: Marea is the recipient of the 2010 James Beard Award for Best New Restaurant and has received three stars from The New York Times. It has also been recognized as Best New Restaurant by Bon Appetit, Esquire, and GQ Magazines, and named NYC’s Best Italian Restaurant by Zagat.

bio.description: The Musket Room is a globally-inspired fine dining restaurant located in downtown Manhattan, known for its intimate atmosphere and thoughtful approach to cooking and hospitality. Since its opening in 2013, it has retained a Michelin star for a decade, becoming a beloved dining destination that offers a chef’s prix fixe menu alongside seasonal à la carte options. The restaurant features cozy nooks, a long cocktail bar, and a lush outdoor garden, making it a favored spot for al fresco dining.
bio.culinary_style: The Musket Room focuses on New American cuisine, emphasizing seasonal ingredients and bold flavors. The menu is crafted by Executive Chef Mary Attea and Chef de Cuisine Noah Ponjuan, featuring a prix fixe format complemented by rotating à la carte dishes. Signature techniques include a playful approach to bread service and desserts, overseen by Executive Pastry Chef Onika Brown.
bio.history: The Musket Room was established in 2013 and is the first restaurant of Elizabeth Street Hospitality, founded by sisters Jennifer and Nicole Vitagliano. The restaurant has maintained a Michelin star for a decade and is shaped by a diverse team whose backgrounds and travels inform its culinary and hospitality approach.

bio.description: Russ & Daughters Café is a celebrated establishment that embodies the rich culinary heritage of New York City, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere for both locals and visitors. The café is renowned for its dedication to quality and tradition, providing a unique dining experience that pays homage to the iconic Russ & Daughters appetizing store.
bio.culinary_style: The café specializes in Jewish deli cuisine, featuring a menu that includes classic bagels, smoked fish, and traditional spreads. Guests can enjoy a variety of dishes in a casual dining format, with an emphasis on fresh, high-quality ingredients and time-honored recipes.
bio.history: Russ & Daughters has a long-standing legacy, having been established in 1914, and is known for its commitment to preserving the cultural significance of Jewish culinary traditions.

bio.description: Una Pizza Napoletana, located in New York's Lower East Side, offers an intimate dining experience centered around the artistry of Neapolitan-style pizza. The restaurant features a unique ambiance adorned with one-of-a-kind art pieces, where guests can observe Chef Anthony Mangieri skillfully handcrafting pizzas in a wood-fired oven. With a commitment to quality and detail, Una Pizza Napoletana has earned accolades as the #1 pizzeria in the world by 50 Top Pizza for multiple years and has been recognized by prominent media outlets.
bio.culinary_style: The culinary focus is on naturally-leavened, wood-fired pizzas, complemented by a selection of appetizers, made-daily ice cream, and seasonal sorbetto. The menu emphasizes high-quality ingredients and traditional techniques, with a limited number of pizzas baked at a time to ensure perfection.
bio.history: Anthony Mangieri, a pioneer of Neapolitan-style pizza in the United States, opened the first Una Pizza Napoletana in 1996. After several relocations, the restaurant returned to New York's Lower East Side in 2022, following a significant transformation of the space.

bio.description: ABCV is a vibrant American restaurant located in New York, NY, that champions a plant-forward dining experience. Helmed by renowned chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten and culinary director Neal Harden, the restaurant offers a luminous and inviting atmosphere that reflects its commitment to wellness and sustainability. With a focus on organic and innovative dishes, ABCV welcomes all diners to explore its creative menu, which is designed to inspire a cultural shift towards plant-based eating.
bio.culinary_style: ABCV specializes in plant-forward, sustainable, and organic cuisine. The menu features a variety of vegan and gluten-free options, with an emphasis on wellness through food. Signature techniques include the use of tonics and elixirs that promote health and vitality.
bio.history: ABCV sprouted from abc kitchen and is inspired by Jean-Georges’ personal journey as well as the cultural shift towards a plant-based future. The restaurant has been recognized in the New York Times Top 100.

bio.description: Cosme is a contemporary restaurant located in New York City’s Flatiron District, founded by renowned Chef Enrique Olvera. The restaurant offers a vibrant dining experience that celebrates Mexican flavors and traditions, utilizing local and seasonal ingredients to create memorable dishes. With a focus on artisanal spirits and high-quality ingredients, Cosme aims to provide guests with an authentic taste of Mexican culture in a warm and inviting atmosphere.
bio.culinary_style: Cosme specializes in contemporary Mexican cuisine, featuring a menu that highlights seasonal ingredients and traditional flavors. The dining format includes a la carte options as well as family-style dishes, allowing guests to share and experience a variety of flavors. Signature techniques include innovative presentations and the use of artisanal ingredients.
bio.history: Enrique Olvera is the Chef Founder of Cosme, which reflects his dedication to Mexican culinary traditions and local sourcing.

bio.description: Dim Sum Go Go is a Michelin-rated restaurant located in the heart of Chinatown, New York City, celebrated for its fresh, made-to-order dim sum. With a contemporary ambiance, the restaurant offers a vibrant dining experience that honors traditional Chinese cuisine while incorporating modern twists. Known for its meticulous preparation and high-quality ingredients, Dim Sum Go Go has established itself as a go-to destination for dim sum enthusiasts since its opening in 2000.
bio.culinary_style: The restaurant specializes in Cantonese dim sum, featuring a menu that includes delicate dumplings and savory buns. Dishes are crafted with authentic flavors and a focus on freshness, with orders taken by staff rather than traditional carts to ensure quality. Signature items include sweet shrimp wrapped in rice paper and rich duck dumplings.
bio.history: Established in 2000, Dim Sum Go Go has been recognized as the Best Dim Sum in New York City for over 24 years.
